svg.text: PROPOSED CONSTRUCTION • Dimensions in mm • Orthographic • One shared master • Not creator approved
Source axes: X length / muzzle-forward, Y width, Z up. Front is viewed from +X; back from -X.
Overall X 2000.0 × Y 1000.0 × Z 1200.0 mm. All six panels use the same scale.
Grid: 200 mm. Clean PNG full-frame size: 2.500m square; 2048px. Raster pitch 1.221mm/px. Do not trace the dimensioned sheet as a scale image.
